title: A Non-integer Dimensional Space Approach to the Moisil-Teodorescu Operator
summary: The vector calculus in non-integer dimensional space (NIDS), including the NIDS version of the standard vector differential operators (gradient, divergence, and curl) is well-known. A deformation of the quaternionic Moisil-Teodorescu operator, written in terms of NIDS derivatives is the main purpose of this article. Along similar lines, we consider the NIDS reformulation of the quaternionic Bitsadze operator and the Lamé-Navier operator of the three-dimensional elasticity theory.
